title: datumAxis
body:
## datumAxis

Create an editable Body-owned line from an origin in mm and a nonzero direction. It provides a durable typed rotation reference for bodyRevolve or groove and does not advance the solid tip. Use an arbitrary datum when a Body origin X/Y/Z axis does not express the turned feature’s intent.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Line`. Output kind: `["axis"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origin` | World X/Y/Z sketch or datum origin in mm, default zero. For a profile it combines with the plane shortcut; explicit frame or onFace must replace non-default plane/origin. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `direction` | Nonzero world direction of the datum axis, default +Z. Magnitude is normalised; origin locates the rotation line. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,1]` |
